stemMd:
The town's oldest public clock ______ was repaired last year after residents raised funds to replace its damaged gears. It now marks the hour for the first time in decades.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.label: A
options.textMd: : which stands above the market hall,

options.label: B
options.textMd: which stand above the market hall

options.label: C
options.textMd: ; which stands above the market hall,

options.label: D
options.textMd: , which stands above the market hall,

explanationMd: The relative clause adds information about the identified clock and must be enclosed in commas. The complete subject resumes with was repaired after the closing comma.

distractorRationale.a: A colon does not introduce this parenthetical relative clause correctly.
distractorRationale.b: The singular antecedent clock cannot take the plural verb stand.
distractorRationale.c: A semicolon cannot introduce a dependent relative clause.
